data.summary_suggestion: Generate AI-powered content for a dataset
data.description_suggestion: Generates AI-powered content for documents in a specified dataset using LLM instructions. Accepts an instruction with optional parameters and targets to define which document fields to generate. By default, generated content is written to the source document; use `targetDocument` to write to a different document. Returns the modified document with generated content. Supports partial updates - only specified targets are modified.

data.current_summary: Make a schema-aware patch to a document
data.current_description:
A schema-aware patch API that validates the provided paths and values against the target schema.
This operation doesn't use an LLM and only uses regular Sanity billing for API requests.
Unknown properties in the request body are rejected with a `400`.

Examples and implementation details can be found in the [Patch documentation](https://www.sanity.io/docs/agent-actions/patch-quickstart).
data.description_suggestion: Applies schema-validated patches to a document without using an LLM. Validates all provided paths and values against the target document's schema before applying changes. Rejects unknown properties in the request body with a 400 error. Returns the patched document with applied changes. Uses standard Sanity API billing (not LLM-based billing). Supports partial updates - only specified paths are modified.
data.reasoning: Summary is clear and action-oriented. Description needs enhancement to clarify what gets returned, emphasize the validation behavior, and document partial update support.
